cards.card_text: Then Jacob gives Esau some bread and lentil stew.
cards.verse_text: Then Jacob gave some bread and lentil stew to Esau, who ate and drank and then got up and went away.

cards.card_text: They bring beds, basins, clay pots, wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils, honey, curds, sheep and cheese.
cards.verse_text: They brought beds, basins, and earthen vessels, as well as wheat, barley, flour, roasted grain, beans, lentils, honey, curds, sheep, and cheese from the herd for David and his people to eat.

cards.card_text: The Philistines band together near a field full of lentils.
cards.verse_text: When the Philistines had banded together near a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.
cards.snippet: When the Philistines had banded together near a field full of lentils, Israel’s troops fled from them.

cards.card_text: Now God gives Ezekiel the menu for his 390 days on his side: wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet and spelt, all made into bread for himself.
cards.verse_text: But take wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt; put them in a single container and make them into bread for yourself.
